text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a new set of spatially explicit land-use change scenarios for the entire country of Brazil, modeling six land cover classes from 2000 to 2050. The modeling framework (LuccME) is spatial, and model performance is validated using quantitative accuracy metrics (multiresolution adjustment validation metric, omission/commission errors).
